title: INC-1012: service-a memory leak from unbounded session cache
content: HighMemory fired for service-a: RSS grew from 80MB to 410MB over 40 minutes. Shortly after, the error rate rose to 30% as requests timed out during long GC pauses. Root cause: a session cache with no eviction. Restarting the pod brought memory back to 70MB and errors to zero within 20 seconds. Fix shipped later: cache size limit.

title: INC-1027: service-b 5xx spike after release 2.3.0
content: HighErrorRate fired for service-b four minutes after release 2.3.0. 70% of requests failed with a null reference error in the order handler. Memory and traffic were normal. A restart was tried and did not help. Rolling back to 2.2.4 (approved by the on-call engineer) fixed it immediately.

title: INC-1033: service-a latency during marketing campaign
content: HighLatency fired for service-a: p95 rose to 2.8s while request rate tripled during an email campaign. Error rate stayed under 1%, memory normal, CPU at 100%. Scaling from 2 to 5 replicas brought p95 back under 300ms within a minute.

title: INC-1041: payments database outage caused errors in service-b
content: HighErrorRate fired for service-b with 85% of requests failing on connection timeouts to the payments database, which was down for maintenance by another team. The agent's restart made no difference. Escalated to the database team; errors stopped when the database came back.

title: INC-1048: OOM crash loop on service-a after restart
content: service-a was OOMKilled, restarted, and was OOMKilled again 6 minutes later, three times within an hour. Health checks flapped. Restarts only bought minutes each time. Root cause: memory limit set too low after a new image doubled baseline usage. Escalated; fixed by raising the limit.

title: INC-1061: service-a errors from a poisoned connection pool
content: HighErrorRate fired for service-a: 90% of requests returned 500 after a brief network blip. No deploy or config change that day, dependencies healthy, memory normal. Connections in the pool were stuck in a broken state and never recycled. Restarting the pod rebuilt the pool and errors dropped to zero within 15 seconds.

title: INC-1055: feature flag typo broke service-b checkout
content: HighErrorRate fired for service-b: 100% of checkout requests returned 500 with 'invalid flag value'. A config change two minutes earlier had a typo in a feature flag. Memory and traffic were normal. Escalated; reverting the config fixed it. A restart would have reloaded the same bad config.
